newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sells stake in small trading firm.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sells stake in small trading firm.

text.p: Croatia's state privatisation agency sold its 33.33 percent interest in small trading firm Orto, the Zagreb Stock Exchange reported on Thursday.
The stake was sold for 25,333 German marks to Ceufin Brokers at a cash auction of the Croatian Privatisation Fund holdings, it said in a press release.
The fund today offered stakes ranging between under one and 38 percent in 28 mostly smaller firms.
Apart from cash sales, it also holds Monday auctions on the bourse for the remaining shares in its portfolio that are payable in public debt notes at a discount of up to 30 percent.
But investor interest has weakened considerably since the most attractive and profitable companies were sold.
